inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "The camp of the last five survivors of a cult of cyborg flesh beings, an intergalactic species from a Type 4 civilization: their leader and his four first officers, all heavily damaged, who fled with only what they could carry after the Sovereign destroyed their army in one second. They have stopped on a barren, desolate, empty stretch of bare natural land where nothing grows and nobody ever built anything. The only objects in the whole picture are a few small pieces of their own advanced alien technology that they carried with them, made of pearly opalescent shell with iridescent hexagonal scale cells and rose gold trims, deep plum astral cloth with a starfield inside it, and dark gunmetal with glowing orange glyph seams. Rendered entirely in crisp, deliberately clustered pixel art. Modern high quality pixel art like Sea of Stars: bright, colourful and readable, never muddy. No people anywhere, the officers are added later. This land, a bare windswept stone plateau high above a sea of white clouds. Around the camp stand the unfolded pieces of their emergency kit.", "style_description": {"medium": "pixel_art", "art_style": "Authentic hand pixelled 2D game battle stage background. Visible square pixel clusters and stair stepped contours everywhere. Flat colour clusters, two to four shades per material. Crisp pixel edges without antialiasing. Clean readable shapes. No paint brushwork, no gradients except a dithered sky, no noise texture.", "aesthetics": "a bright readable barren desolate land, vast and empty, with a few small pieces of advanced alien technology, coherent pixel clusters, a real place with depth and scale", "lighting": "Clear cold morning sun from the upper left, cool blue shadows, as discrete flat pixel colour planes, the ground in calm even light.", "color_palette": ["#2a6ab8", "#bfe0f4", "#ffffff", "#6a88b0", "#d4c4a4", "#b0a084", "#7c7480", "#ece4ee", "#a898b8", "#4a2350", "#a050e0", "#f2a24a", "#2e2c38", "#e0a070"]}, "compositional_deconstruction": {"background": "One game camp screen seen from a fixed side oblique camera like a classic arcade game stage, no people. The top part is sky over a distant horizon. Behind the camp the bare land stands in overlapping rows at different depths, hazier and paler the further away. The lower part is one wide open flat bare ground, calm and empty in the middle, with four small work stations of alien technology spread to its corners and the pieces of their emergency kit standing
